security_audit.summary: The four reconnaissance alerts are normal preview and lookup instructions. The 12 shell-backtick alerts identify Markdown code spans, not Ruby execution. However, command templates interpolate user-provided values without explicit argument escaping, creating a medium command-injection risk.

remediation.issue: User-provided values enter shell command templates without explicit safe argument handling.
remediation.suggestion: Require structured argument arrays or strict validation for symbols, IDs, prices, and names. Never concatenate these values into a shell command.

content.user_title: Manage Longbridge Watchlists and Price Alerts
content.value_statement: Managing watchlists, alerts, and public stock lists across separate commands is repetitive. This skill organizes those workflows and requires confirmation before persistent changes.
actual_capabilities: Lists watchlist groups and resolves group IDs before changes.
Creates, renames, or deletes groups after explicit confirmation.
Adds or removes market symbols from watchlist groups.
Lists, creates, enables, disables, and deletes price alerts.
Browses and manages Longbridge community stock lists.
limitations: Requires the Longbridge CLI or compatible MCP tools.
Most watchlist operations require Longbridge login, and some changes require trade scope.
Does not place trades or manage orders.
Command flags may vary, so the skill checks current help before execution.

use_cases.title: Maintain Personal Watchlists
use_cases.description: Review groups, add selected symbols, and remove outdated holdings with confirmation.

use_cases.title: Configure Research Alerts
use_cases.description: Create price thresholds for tracked companies and manage existing alert states.

use_cases.title: Curate Community Lists
use_cases.description: Browse public lists and maintain a subscribed collection of selected market symbols.

prompt_templates.title: List Watchlists
prompt_templates.prompt: List my Longbridge watchlist groups and summarize each group with its ID and symbols.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review existing groups without making changes.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Symbol Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare to add NVDA.US to my Technology group. Show the exact change and wait for my confirmation before execution.
prompt_templates.scenario: Add one stock to an existing group.

prompt_templates.title: Configure a Price Alert
prompt_templates.prompt: Set a falling price alert for TSLA.US at 220 USD. Preview the alert details and request confirmation before creating it.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a complete price alert with a specified direction.

prompt_templates.title: Curate a Community List
prompt_templates.prompt: Review sharelist 123, propose adding AAPL.US and removing TSLA.US, then execute only the changes I explicitly confirm.
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan several changes to a public stock list.

output_examples.input: Add NVDA.US to my Technology group.
output_examples.output: About to add NVDA.US to Technology, group 12345. No other symbols will change. Confirm execution?

best_practices: Provide complete market symbols such as AAPL.US or 700.HK.
Review every preview and confirm only when all identifiers and values are correct.
Use read operations first when a group or alert ID is unknown.
anti_patterns: Do not request a mutation with an ambiguous group, symbol, price, or direction.
Do not bypass the confirmation step or approve changes you have not reviewed.
Do not expect this skill to place trades or provide investment advice.

faq.question: Does this skill place trades?
faq.answer: No. It manages watchlists, price alerts, and community stock lists.

faq.question: Is a Longbridge account required?
faq.answer: Public community lists may be readable without login. Account-specific watchlists and changes require authentication.

faq.question: Why does the skill ask for confirmation?
faq.answer: Changes persist in your Longbridge account. Confirmation lets you verify symbols, IDs, prices, and directions before execution.

faq.question: Which symbol format should I use?
faq.answer: Use the market-qualified format, such as TSLA.US or 700.HK.

faq.question: Can it manage price alert directions?
faq.answer: Yes. Specify whether the alert triggers when price rises above or falls below the target.

faq.question: What happens when a command fails?
faq.answer: The skill reports the error and does not silently retry a mutating operation.
